checklist.note: More than 200 exist; purple icons and black icons with pink letters.
WAiNK app, hold Up then R1. Boats and aircraft count too.
Binoculars: hold L1, zoom with Up, hold R1 to study. Every breed of dog and cat counts separately.
130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Each spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice.
Unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
One for each of the 9 gangs, at least.
Bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, Payday Loans.

bullets: Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house, the one trophy that may be missable: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Keep a manual save at the start and the end of each chapter. There are 15 manual save slots and 1 autosave slot; there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
Do optional missions as they appear. Many disappear after a while, but that does not matter for trophies: there are far more than the 100 the checklist needs.
Scan any new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study any new animal through the binoculars. You need 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals for 100%.
All trophy-related quest givers come back after the story, so do not worry if one goes quiet for a chapter.
stages.summary: Finish the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals on the way, since that progress counts toward 100% later. There are no mission medals, so you do not need to watch for hidden objectives.
stages.title: Play the story
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

bullets: Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed, so skip the hardest ones.
Only some collectibles are needed, and only partly: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations.
The tasks that need everything are bank vaults, gang operations, robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Most of the checklist fills itself while you work on the other trophies, so chase the trophy list and check the list when you are nearly done.
stages.summary: After the credits you are returned to the open world and the checklist opens under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The targets are lenient, closer to 60% of true completion, and nothing on it is missable.
stages.title: 100% completion checklist

bullets: Only certain stranger questlines count toward Strangers & Freaks: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.
Character questlines for Andy, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are still available after the story.
Four trophies have no confirmed method yet at launch: In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin. Check the guides for the latest word before hunting them.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, and cheats only unlock after the story, so keep them off for a trophy run.
stages.summary: Most trophies are already earned after the checklist. Finish the 8 stranger strands and the character questlines, then clean up whatever is left.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4 out of 10. No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, no mission medals. The story is five chapters and takes 60 to 80 hours; the 100% checklist is the long part at about 100 hours; Strangers and Freaks plus cleanup take about 10 hours.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum

warnings.text: Positive Mental Attitude: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. Do it in Chapter 1, in the morning after Down to Earth.
warnings.title: One trophy may be missable

warnings.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter; you have 15 manual save slots.
warnings.title: No mission replay

warnings.text: Turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving. Cheats only unlock after the story, so a trophy run should keep them off entirely.
warnings.title: Cheats switch trophies off

warnings.text: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline. Nothing needs GTA Online.
warnings.title: No online trophies
